_what_this_is: The entry picker. `guide` is the four-question flow (what → where → which → how), each answer narrowing the next; every path ends on one of the public profiles, either exactly (`profile`) or as a stand-in (`standin`: the nearest measured profile, named as such in the game and in the telemetry — the set has not met that product yet). `vendors`/`products`/`variants` label the profiles for the agent row and the 'see all' list.

anthropic/claude-code/local-confirmation.sub: auto mode, always allow, a skip-permissions flag

anthropic/claude-code-remote/ccr-contain.sub: a remote session container, a repo attached

anthropic/claude-web/connectors-on.sub: a drive, mail, a code host…

openai/chatgpt-web/default.sub: paste in, read what comes back

generic/browser-extension/broad-host-per.sub: read and change data on all sites
